impact: shared Page.PropertyChanged retains prior ShellContent instances (#37217)
root_cause: Transient ShellContent subscribes to a shared, longer-lived Page's PropertyChanged and is only unsubscribed if the child is removed, so the page roots every ShellContent.

impact: shared ResourceDictionary keeps every element it was assigned to alive (per PR, #36389)
root_cause: Elements subscribe to a possibly shared, long-lived ResourceDictionary's strong event and never unsubscribe on unload, so the dictionary roots them.

impact: memory leak in TerminalTabViewModel (closed tabs retained via Loc.PropertyChanged)
root_cause: Per-tab view model subscribes a lambda to the app-wide localization service's PropertyChanged and never unsubscribes, so closed tabs stay reachable from the long-lived service.

impact: singleton store's delegate list rooted every classifier and every .feature ITextBuffer opened during the VS session
root_cause: Short-lived classifier subscribes to an event on a process-wide singleton store and never unsubscribes, so the store's invocation list roots every classifier and its text buffer.

impact: navigated-away control and its list kept alive for the rest of the session (code comment)
root_cause: control subscribes to an application-lifetime view model and only unsubscribes when its DataContext changes, which does not happen when navigation drops the control

impact: stale Changed handlers accumulate per rebuild and fire redundantly (test: invocation list 18 -> 26)
root_cause: child view models subscribe to the longer-lived session's Changed event in their constructors; BuildChildren overwrote 7 of them without unsubscribing

impact: never-attached rendered documents kept alive by the application and re-rendered on every theme switch
root_cause: renderers subscribe to the app-lived Application.PropertyChanged at render time and unsubscribe only on logical-tree detach, which never fires for content that was never attached

impact: view models stay in memory after navigation, growing ~3 MB per page visit
root_cause: old AdaptiveTriggers stay subscribed to the long-lived Window.SizeChanged when VisualStateGroups are replaced after attach, and each trigger strongly references its VisualElement

impact: RAM climbs to ~1.3 GB vs ~600-700 MB fresh after a day of opening/closing sessions
root_cause: per-session header badge subscribes to a plugin-lifetime tracker event and relies on a visual-detach callback that does not fire when a session closes

impact: each Disconnect->Connect cycle leaked the previous GATT service object (native GATT session handle)
root_cause: Teardown method nulls a field holding a WinRT GattDeviceService (native GATT session) without disposing it, on every reconnect.

impact: Unix semaphore (and shared-memory) leaks when the last queue participant exits
root_cause: Named POSIX semaphore/shared-memory objects are closed per process but no participant takes responsibility for unlinking them, so they persist after the last user exits.

impact: one DbContext leaked per commit on the inline projection path
root_cause: inline EF-backed projections register a DbContext participant on the session, but only the async-daemon batch ever drained/disposed participants

impact: leaked the process handle and port; cleanup exception masked the validation result
root_cause: Release (Dispose) of a temporary core process sits after a throwing StopAsync in the same cleanup block, so a throw skips it.

impact: each failed connection attempt leaked a ServiceBusClient (#1187)
root_cause: A client acquired before a throwing verification step is only handed to the caller on success and never disposed on the failure path.

impact: connected MCP client leaked per failed discovery attempt (PR statement)
root_cause: newly connected MCP client not disposed when tool/prompt discovery throws before it is published

impact: on a failed build the DI container leaks undisposed with live background loops (PR statement)
root_cause: service provider created and background workers started before steps that can throw, with no cleanup on the exception path

impact: NotSupportedException on every SSE client disconnect/stall (unhandled exception in Kestrel)
root_cause: An async enumerator is disposed while a MoveNextAsync abandoned by a WhenAny race is still in flight.

impact: native pipeline/decoder/demux state freed while still in use by the running pass (use after free)
root_cause: Async disposal frees native resources while the asynchronous run that uses them is still executing.

impact: HTTP-sourced public data import always failed with ObjectDisposedException
root_cause: request-scoped injected HttpClient captured by a background work item that runs after the request scope disposed it

impact: unobserved ObjectDisposedException (39 production events in ~7 months); real persistence failures masked
root_cause: detached task outlives the request and dereferences the recycled HttpContext and its request-scoped services

impact: timeout behavior could not cancel the handler (handler keeps running after TimeoutException)
root_cause: Timeout implemented as a WhenAny race without token propagation, so a timed-out handler keeps running (and its later fault is unobserved).

impact: one leaked linked CTS + registration on the external token per processor per session
root_cause: A linked CancellationTokenSource created per Start is never disposed, leaving its registration on the caller's longer-lived token.

impact: an unobserved throw in the file-watcher handler could kill the process (per PR)
root_cause: Async lambda passed to Subscribe(Action<T>) becomes async void, so its exceptions escape to the thread pool.

impact: an ordinary Fedora failure in the keep-alive callback could crash the process (per PR/issue #250)
root_cause: An async void method used as a System.Threading.Timer callback lets exceptions from its awaits escape, which terminates the process.

impact: abandoned guard task exceptions surface as UnobservedTaskException
root_cause: A navigation-guard task abandoned on the cancellation branch of a WhenAny race is never observed, so its exception is lost/raised as UnobservedTaskException.

impact: failed or cancelled receiver close silently lost (orphaned sessions/renewal loops unreported)
root_cause: fire-and-forget CloseAsync in Dispose with no observation of its outcome

impact: every normal stop ended in an unhandled ObjectDisposedException; Linux exit -6 with core dump
root_cause: The DI container owns the same instance through two registrations and disposes it twice; Dispose was not idempotent and cancelled an already-disposed CTS.

impact: concurrent callers could each dispose _semaphore while a racing BucketAsync still awaits/releases it (per PR)
root_cause: Non-atomic check-then-set of the disposed flag lets concurrent Dispose calls each run the disposal body.

impact: next run on a reused engine throws ObjectDisposedException on the assembly-setup gate
root_cause: A per-run cleanup method disposes a SemaphoreSlim whose owner is the long-lived, reused engine.

impact: scope (and its view model) double-disposed when DisposeAsync runs during deferred disposal
root_cause: An IServiceScope handed to a deferred-disposal task remained registered in the service's pending-disposal set, giving it two owners that could both dispose it when the service is disposed concurrently.

impact: a reference holder could close the file of a document still in use (PR statement)
root_cause: the shared reader exposed to every object reference as Source was IDisposable, letting any holder close the document's file

impact: ObjectDisposedException at startup migration
root_cause: startup code disposes the DbContext-owned connection obtained from GetDbConnection(), which the context reuses for Migrate()

impact: concurrent Dispose could double-record telemetry and dispose the Activity twice (not reproduced)
root_cause: non-atomic one-shot dispose flag lets two concurrent Dispose calls both run teardown

impact: default no-Redis cache retained expired keys in its membership index indefinitely while a key stays live
root_cause: A cache key-membership index only ever grows: entries are added per write, never expire, and the whole index is renewed for 30 days on each write.

impact: cache and per-key SemaphoreSlim dictionary grew for the life of the server with user-driven keys
root_cause: A long-lived cache and its per-key lock dictionary add entries for user-driven keys and never evict them.

impact: loaded logo images (unmanaged memory) kept for the rest of the session (code comment)
root_cause: long-lived service caches every loaded logo image without bound and drops them on refresh without releasing their unmanaged memory

impact: closed sessions (view models, transcript visual tree) stay rooted; RAM growth over a day of use
root_cause: plugin-lifetime dictionary keyed by pane is only ever added to, pinning every closed session's context

impact: ObjectDisposedException: Cannot access a disposed context instance (ChatCoreDbContext)
root_cause: A component whose work runs after the request scope (fire-and-forget) holds a scoped repository/DbContext from that scope.

impact: captive-dependency crash at startup under Development scope validation; latent DbContext sharing across concurrent evaluations
root_cause: A singleton-registered evaluator consumes a scoped policy list (policies may depend on a host DbContext), capturing one scope's instances for the process lifetime.

impact: captive/root-scope dependency risk; can fail under scope validation (per PR)
root_cause: The DI integration allowed registering the mediator as singleton although it resolves scoped handlers through the provider it captured.

impact: Development host refused to start: 'Cannot consume scoped service ILookupNormalizer from singleton'
root_cause: A singleton rate limiter captures a scoped Identity service via its constructor.

impact: Development DI validation threw InvalidOperationException for the captive dependency; production silently shared the scoped service
root_cause: A singleton bot-message distributor holds a scoped report service injected at construction.

impact: scoped dependency (e.g. current user, DbContext) from the first request reused by every later request
root_cause: lazily created framework singletons (validators, mappers, event handlers) are constructed from the first request's scope and cached for the process, capturing scoped dependencies outside DI scope validation

impact: gauges would read through a disposed scope and silently report zero capacity (dormant: meter not registered before this PR)
root_cause: singleton metrics object captures delegates bound to a scoped service instance and its scoped repository

impact: one half-open socket stranded per same-version redeploy; block-owned clients disposed only at process exit
root_cause: per-block receivers resolved from the root IServiceProvider, so their transient IDisposable dependencies (Modbus/HTTP clients) are tracked and kept by the root container

impact: pooled encode buffer leaked (not returned) when the codec throws
root_cause: A rented pool buffer is returned only by the downstream enqueue, so a throw between Rent and the hand-off skips the return.

impact: flush/clock wait after dispose threw ObjectDisposedException (#723)
root_cause: Teardown cancels and then disposes a CTS whose token is still read by flush/clock-wait paths that can run after (or concurrently with) disposal.

impact: ObjectDisposedException from _semaphore.Release() replaced the bootstrap result/real error when Dispose ran during BucketAsync
root_cause: A semaphore field is disposed by Dispose while a concurrent async call still holds it and releases it afterwards.

impact: mobile client showed 'An error has occurred' after a successful message exchange
root_cause: Hub event handlers fire on thread-pool threads after the component is disposed and touch the disposed renderer.

impact: ObjectDisposedException from StopAsync on WebApplicationFactory disposal; ~178 cascading test failures in a consumer run
root_cause: A CancellationTokenSource disposed in the scheduler's DisposeAsync is still used by a concurrently running hosted-service StopAsync when two host shutdown sequences race.

impact: Blazor Server circuit killed by ObjectDisposedException when navigating while a tooltip/submenu is closing
root_cause: component resumes after an await in OnAfterRenderAsync and uses its DotNetObjectReference that a concurrent Dispose/DisposeAsync already released

impact: every caller received an already-disposed ServiceBusReceiver (benign by timing)
root_cause: registration factory opens a DI scope, resolves a scoped IDisposable from it and returns it after the using disposes the scope (and the instance)

impact: use after unmap of PKCS#11 module code during concurrent dispose; abandoned session's C_CloseSession never issued
root_cause: A disposed-flag check does not keep a native module mapped for the duration of a concurrent call, so Dispose can finalize and unmap it under an in-flight call.

impact: EF 'A second operation was started on this context instance' under overlapping operations (same root cause crashed /mangas, #476)
root_cause: Parallel integrity-check workers reach a scoped service that uses the single shared DbContext.

impact: concurrent use of one DbContext from several threads (EF forbids; per code comment)
root_cause: A live EF async stream is enumerated while parallel loop bodies use the same DbContext.

impact: concurrent requests interleaved on one connection; another request's writes rolled back with a foreign transaction (per PR)
root_cause: One non-thread-safe SqliteConnection owned by a singleton store is used concurrently by unrelated requests, including inside each other's transactions.

impact: intermittent NullReferenceException from CancellationTokenSource.get_WaitHandle in concurrent mapper initialization (CI)
root_cause: A CancellationTokenSource whose token is shared with concurrent waiters via a published cache entry is disposed by the publishing caller.

impact: in-flight MCP tool calls cancelled on reconnect and reported as timeouts
root_cause: reconnect disposes a client that concurrent calls are still using; per-server state in eight unsynchronised dictionaries

impact: after N sends each ack invokes the settle handler N times; O(N^2) subscribe cost; extra confirm.select per send
root_cause: publisher-confirm handlers subscribed and ConfirmSelect called on every send over a long-lived channel, with no unsubscribe on reset or dispose

impact: an immediate second server add answered 429 'A server add is already running' for a slot already free; CI test flake
root_cause: The handler acquires a one-slot gate but delegates its release to a detached continuation that can run after the response is sent.

impact: concurrency slots permanently lost; pump eventually deadlocks and the queue silently stops being consumed
root_cause: semaphore slot release (and CTS disposal) lives in the finally of a Task.Run delegate whose scheduling token can cancel before the delegate starts

impact: wrong advice: 'can return void' for awaited Task<T> (per PR)
root_cause: Analyzer diagnostic message ignored awaitable return types.

impact: FAQ documents chunked incorrectly (title: 'fix chunking of FAQs')
root_cause: Overload resolution turned the second separator char into the count argument.

impact: unstated (caller cannot match OCE.CancellationToken to its own token)
root_cause: Caller cancellation surfaced as an OperationCanceledException bound to an internal linked/timeout token instead of the caller's token.

impact: pure timeouts surface as Canceled depending on race outcome (flaky test)
root_cause: cancellation outcome classified by exception type alone, so a timeout that wins the race inside the queued work is reported as caller cancellation

impact: lifetime token cancelled 60 s after load; persistence, tracking, history and DB maintenance silently disabled for the session
root_cause: plugin-lifetime CancellationTokenSource linked to a load-scoped timeout token, so a load timeout cancels the long-lived lifetime

impact: projects with GenerateDocumentationFile + TreatWarningsAsErrors fail to build (CS1570/CS1574/CS1584/CS1658)
root_cause: generator emitted doc crefs that do not resolve for inherited members, ref/out/in parameters and tuples

impact: a reset could be observed in the middle of an initialization (per PR, #42)
root_cause: Reset cleared initialization state without the initialization lock, so a reset could be observed mid-initialization.

impact: dashboard could silently return fewer workers than exist (per PR)
root_cause: Unsynchronised List<T>.Add from concurrently running async lambdas.

impact: test-suite hang caught with a dump: receiver parked with a frame queued and no permit to wake it
root_cause: Wake-up signalling via a cancellable SemaphoreSlim wait racing a timer poll could drop the permit; busy flag updated at the wrong point.

impact: PropertyChanged events fired during Subscribe silently dropped
root_cause: Concat subscribes to the PropertyChanged source only after the initial value is delivered, so events raised in that window (and during deep-chain re-walks) are lost

impact: host update fence never acknowledged while the dispatch channel is idle
root_cause: host-update pause was only checked on the trigger path, so an idle dispatcher never acknowledged quiescence

impact: NewHeadBlock handler deadlocks; Shutter validator node stops following the chain
root_cause: CancellationTokenRegistration.Dispose called while holding a lock that the registration's timeout callback also acquires

impact: repeated helper calls double side effects (domain events, audit entries) or override configuration
root_cause: registration helpers are not idempotent, so a repeated call registers handlers/services twice; two helpers keep a process-static 'registered' flag

impact: one plugin instance initialized twice; second Initialize overwrites the first (per PR tests)
root_cause: Unkeyed DI lookup returned another scheduler's plugin registration in a multi-scheduler container.

impact: /health returned 500; control image acceptance failed (not ready within 300 s)
root_cause: module health-check registration forwarded to the root container, whose HealthCheckService activates the check with the root provider that cannot see module-owned services

impact: nine reviewer launches reaped during a vendor cert surfaced as 'unknown failure'/auth hint; ~2 hours lost (per PR)
root_cause: Reap reasons were dropped between daemon and flow caller, which reported a generic launch/handshake failure instead.

impact: 5xx/dropped connection shown as 'scene not found' or 'no scenes'; failed re-read cleared the live log (per PR)
root_cause: Service wrappers swallowed transport/server failures into null or empty results.

impact: Stop Loop during a cycle's config read stopped the whole Scheduler process
root_cause: Exception filter excluded the stop-requested cancellation path, so the exception escaped a BackgroundService.ExecuteAsync.

impact: downloaded file corrupted with the previous file's trailing bytes while reporting success
root_cause: destination opened with File.OpenWrite, which does not truncate an existing longer file

impact: stamina refunds could exceed the stamina spent (refund loops)
root_cause: authored weapon hit refunds bypassed the actual-spend cap applied to passive refunds

impact: WMS/WFS projection crashed mid-recovery on 8 Oct: duplicate key in road.GelijkgrondseKruisingen
root_cause: Projection handlers assumed create events are delivered once and inserted blindly.

impact: ArgumentOutOfRangeException crash when unpinning the oldest gift (crash telemetry 12.10.7.0)
root_cause: Insertion index computed against the list before the element's own removal shifted it.

impact: subsequent requests in a batch aborted by one malformed item (per PR title/issue)
root_cause: A malformed (non-object) batch item aborted processing of the remaining JSON-RPC batch.

impact: tail of the rented buffer holds whatever an earlier unrelated read left there (stale values returned)
root_cause: Reader trusted the footer's row count, leaving the tail of a pooled (uncleared) buffer unwritten and then consumed.

impact: canvas completely resets at sentence boundaries; input filter not remembered on startup
root_cause: Offset unit mismatch (sentence-relative vs buffer-absolute) re-rooted the model; setting not saved.

impact: read-only Validate blocked on a real rekordbox 6 installation
root_cause: Reader treated the reserved 'root' parent sentinel as a missing row.

impact: LST/hour angle/topocentric transforms off by up to 0.9 s of UT1 (~13 arcsec hour angle)
root_cause: Ported code returned a constant 0 for UT1-UTC instead of looking it up.

impact: exception at RetireReleasedPlaybacks() line 138 on next frame; null disposal on tree exit
root_cause: A possibly-null native playback handle is stored unconditionally and dereferenced/disposed later.

impact: any peer holding an accepted mesh secret could stamp another cluster's origin id (per PR)
root_cause: Security options/filters failed open: credential not bound to claimed origin by default; scope kind ignored; per-tool filter skipped when operation detail absent.

impact: a standing admin could mark a provision request as governed by an unrelated executing activity (per PR)
root_cause: Governed claim never checked where it was made; later reader raced on current activity state.

impact: a filename such as 'log.bin\nSYSTem:REboot' would reach the device as two commands (per PR)
root_cause: Unvalidated filename embedded into a quoted SCPI argument allowed injection of a second device command.

impact: anyone could start signed winapp.exe and make it load an arbitrary DLL (per PR)
root_cause: Child process trusted DLL/script paths from its arguments, so a signed winapp.exe could be pointed at an arbitrary DLL.

impact: AlwaysRun cleanup modules / OnPipelineEndAsync / run report could not finish before services were disposed on SIGTERM (implied by PR)
root_cause: On SIGTERM the process-exit handler cancelled and disposed the pipeline fire-and-forget while the run (cleanup modules, report) was still executing.

impact: queued items ran with outdated steering, QG and provider configs (per PR title/#2171)
root_cause: Configuration snapshot frozen into the queued payload instead of being resolved at dispatch.

impact: idle connections dropped after RequestTimeout (implied by regression tests 'staying connected past RequestTimeout')
root_cause: Per-read request timeout applied even when no request was outstanding, tearing down idle connections.

impact: 1,710-5,610 serialization aborts per two-minute load run on one popular product, each retried
root_cause: Consumer transactions ran at REPEATABLE READ while serialising on a FOR UPDATE row lock, so each waiter aborted with a serialization failure.

impact: controls taken out of the visual tree and put back kept showing their old state (#643)
root_cause: Subscription torn down in a detach callback with no matching re-establishment in the attach callback.

impact: a timer that keeps throwing could stack crash dialogs without end (PR statement)
root_cause: crash dialog shown from a handler that the dialog's nested message loop can re-enter

impact: selection state reset on Editor -> Record navigation; Escape indistinguishable from confirming the same region
root_cause: page constructed a fresh view model on every navigation, losing capture-mode/selection state; picker did not show the remembered region or distinguish cancel

impact: class changes on the source silently stop propagating to the target after GC
root_cause: inline lambda passed to Avalonia WeakSubscribe has no strong root, so the subscription is collected and source class changes stop propagating
